reviewer.evidence:
All 12 family/shared slices were independently read for meaning, register, script, technical terms, and unintended English prose. An AST-based source review confirmed full key coverage, default-key order within every slice, placeholder multisets, and the locale’s CLDR plural-category set. The scaffold report was also used for untranslated-entry discovery and syntax parsing. No tests, builds, typechecks, or gates were run. Corrections: Corrected the toast count grammar, citation terminology, provenance wording, audio-versus-voice label, and selection action for adding a citation. Clarified dimensions and media seek position, corrected the preferred-contact label, localized notebook output actions, translated the box-plot summary, and fixed a sequence-empty label. Terminology uncertainties: Contemporary Filipino software copy naturally code-switches for terms such as “prompt”, “node”, “edge”, “canvas”, and “embedding”; a Filipino product glossary may prefer a more localized set. Not claimed; this is an AI-assisted independent semantic review. Allowlist has 123 message paths with per-path rationales. Native-speaker certification is not claimed.
